name: GStory Image to Video
tagline: Image-to-video from one still plus an optional motion prompt. Free daily tries, then credits.
description: GStory Image to Video turns one still — a product photo, portrait, travel shot, or illustration — into a short clip. The still is the first frame. The motion prompt is optional; leave it empty and the model chooses the movement, or write one main action plus a camera move. You can write and test a prompt without an account. Official wording: free users get 2 free generations daily; some models include a free attempt; later runs use credits, and the estimated cost is shown before you generate. Pay-as-you-go credit packs are one-time purchases with no subscription; purchased credits do not expire. Clip length and audio depend on the selected model; default resolution shown is 768p.
